title: Volunteering with the Farms at Trinity Health
venue: The Farms at Trinity Health - Ann Arbor (5557 McAuley Dr., Ypsilanti,  MI, 48197
description: Join Honors College staff at the Farms at Trinity Health for a few hours of community service! Students can gain 3 hours of community service for each day they participate. Tasks will include farming work, such as harvesting, weeding, mulching, and more.
